rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
conjunction adding to the preceding list
compound with internal sandhi: siddhi-saṃprāptiḥ (attainment of powers) joined with mūlakaulam (root Kaula)

items.question: What additional attainments belong to the root Kaula, O fair-faced one?
premises: The conjunction links these to prior attainments.
Attainment of powers is identified with the root Kaula.
items.inference: The eight attainments, including the attainment of powers, constitute the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The exact referents of the eight items depend on the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: And the eight, along with the attainment of powers, are the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
